name: SwatchPicker
summary: A row or grid of swatches, colour, image or empty, of which one is selected. Choose it for picking among a fixed set of colours or textures; choose ColorPicker for any colour.

inputs.name: swatches
inputs.description: The swatches in order: each a colour (with an optional low-contrast border colour), an image, or empty, with a value; a grid gives them as rows.

inputs.name: layout
inputs.description: A single row, or a column of rows.

inputs.name: shape
inputs.description: No radius, borderRadiusMedium, or a circle.

inputs.name: focusMode
inputs.description: Whether arrow keys or Tab move between swatches.

inputs.name: onSelectionChange
inputs.description: Runs with the clicked swatch's value when the selection changes.

anatomy.name: Root
anatomy.description: A flex container with no padding: a row, or a column of rows for a grid, gapped by the spacing.

anatomy.name: Row
anatomy.description: A grid's row: a flex row of swatches with the spacing's column gap.

anatomy.name: Colour swatch
anatomy.description: A button filled with its colour, a 1px border in its borderColor or colorTransparentStroke, clipped to the shape; an optional icon centred over it and a disabled icon when disabled.

anatomy.name: Image swatch
anatomy.description: A button showing its image as a cover background with a 1px colorTransparentStroke border.

anatomy.name: Empty swatch
anatomy.description: A transparent button with a 1px dashed colorNeutralForeground4 border, standing for no colour.

anatomy.name: Icon
anatomy.description: An optional glyph centred on a colour swatch, 16px at extra-small and small, 20px at medium, 24px at large.

variants.description: 20px swatches with a 16px icon; hover and selection rings one step thinner.
24px swatches with a 16px icon; the selection rings one step thinner.
borderRadiusNone, on the swatch and its focus ring.
borderRadiusMedium, on the swatch and its focus ring.
borderRadiusCircular, on the swatch and its focus ring.

layout.text: The root is a flex row (layout row) or column (grid) with no padding and a 2px (small) or 4px (medium) gap; a grid row is a flex row with the same column gap.

Every swatch kind is a square of 20, 24, 28 or 32px by size, an inline flex centring its icon, no padding, clipped to the shape's radius; the colour swatch's 1px border is its borderColor when given, else colorTransparentStroke, and the empty swatch's is dashed colorNeutralForeground4.
The icon is absolutely centred on the swatch: 16px at extra-small and small, 20px at medium, 24px at large.

states.text: Rest: the swatch's own colour or image inside its 1px border; no ring.

The border gives way to two inset rings: colorBrandStroke1 strokeWidthThick wide inside a colorStrokeFocus1 ring one step wider (Thicker); at extra-small the rings are Thin and Thick. The pointer is a hand.
While pressed the inner ring is colorCompoundBrandStrokePressed at Thicker inside a Focus1 ring at Thickest; at extra-small and small they are Thick and Thicker.
Keyboard focus draws the same two inset rings in colorStrokeFocus2 (Thick) inside colorStrokeFocus1 (Thicker), following the shape's radius; no outline outside.

The selected swatch shows a colorBrandStroke1 ring at Thicker inside a 5px colorStrokeFocus1 ring; hovered it widens to Thickest colorCompoundBrandStrokeHover inside 6px, pressed to Thickest colorCompoundBrandStrokePressed inside 7px, and focused to Thicker colorStrokeFocus2 inside 5px. At small and extra-small the rings are Thick inside Thicker (hover the same in colorCompoundBrandStrokeHover, pressed Thicker inside Thickest).

A disabled colour swatch keeps its colour, shows no hover ring and a not-allowed pointer, and draws its disabled icon in colorNeutralForegroundInverted with a 1px black drop shadow so it reads on any colour.

behaviour.text: Clicking a swatch selects it and reports its value and the swatch through onSelectionChange; a disabled swatch cannot be selected.
With focusMode arrow the picker is one tab stop and arrow keys cycle through its swatches (in a grid, in both directions); with tab each swatch is its own tab stop.

keyboard: arrow keys move between swatches (focusMode arrow)
Enter or Space selects the focused swatch
semantics: each swatch is a button with aria-selected and an aria-label naming its colour or image
the root is a group; a grid's rows are rows

notes.text: Swatch sides (20, 24, 28, 32px), icon sizes (16, 16, 20, 24px), the 1px border, the 2 and 4px spacing and the 5, 6 and 7px selected outer rings are constants in the styles files.
Every ring is an inset box-shadow that replaces the border, so a swatch never grows; a ring pair reads as an inner brand ring and an outer light ring painted over the swatch's own colour.
The image swatch's hover and pressed rings do not shrink at small sizes as the colour swatch's do; only the colour swatch has size-specific ring widths.

Under forced colours the swatches keep their own colours (forced-color-adjust none) and the hover and pressed inner rings read colorBrandStroke2Hover and Pressed, the selected ring colorBrandStroke2Pressed.
